lines.context: Kiara：实测台词，Wiki 核对身份与对话阶段
lines.text: Are you a fan of Reptiles and Amphibians? I can't get enough of them!
lines.zh: 你喜欢爬行动物和两栖动物吗? 我怎么都看不够它们!

lines.context: Kiara：实测台词，Wiki 核对身份与对话阶段
lines.text: They can be very hard to find, but they all have unique abilities.
